findings.description: Packed-tail zero-fill claim holds only for the 'numpy' pack engine, not the default 'numba' engine.
findings.evidence: longwave_primary_b.py:32-33 and proof_record.md:59-60 state packed tail slots are 'zero-filled (as belt and braces)'. pack_block_major (:261-280) does zero-fill, but the default _pack_all_numba path (:368-387) allocates np.empty and _pack2d_kernel/_pack1d_kernel (:330-351) write only lanes < width, leaving tail slots uninitialized; they read as zero in practice only because fresh pages on macOS are zero-filled. No correctness impact: lane loops are bounded to width=min(W, pixels-p0) so slots >= width are never loaded (source + IR confirmed). Reword at the next capability re-issue.

findings.evidence: ir_audit.py:142 builds make_longwave_primary_b(4, parallel) only. findings.description: Claims verified true that go beyond what reruns alone show (recorded for the selection ledger).
findings.evidence: (1) Typed graph: B's per-patch statement sequence is textually identical to A lines 92-177 (blob 27ba6ce4...) in operand order, grouping, and every np.float32 rounding node, for both gate paths and both sweeps; accumulator update order A8,A7,A3,A2 (gate true) / A7,A2 (false) preserved; reflection only from A0+lup with np.float32(np.pi) (= 0x40490FDB); output folds are ordered left, columns 2..6 = A5..A9. (2) Truth tables: (x==k) is False for NaN on both short-circuit and branchless forms; all-NaN-sh probe bitwise-matches A. No float op is newly unmasked: the gate remains control flow, so sun/shade expressions are only computed on the taken path (IR: two distinct loop regions; 0 llvm.vector.reduce; the interleaved shuffles belong to the stride-7 output store). (3) Lane mapping: accum[k,lane] is per-block thread-local (allocated inside the prange body), lanes never read each other, tails never read padding. (4) B=0, NaN payloads, -0.0, Inf all bitwise vs both A kernels (reviewer probes).
